# Adel Lajil

> Senior software engineer in Québec, Canada, building .NET APIs, Angular applications, and Azure infrastructure for multi-tenant SaaS platforms and industrial IoT systems. 6+ years of experience, currently Senior Cloud Full-Stack Developer at Evident Industrial, where he maintains provisioning for 5,000+ connected devices across 100+ organizations.
